name: Fresh Wild Alaska Halibut Fillet (Pan-Seared or Steamed)
whyItWorks: Firm, sweet white fish offering 24g of easily assimilated protein per 4 oz serving. Extremely low in fat and virtually free of tough connective collagen.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-sear in a skillet with a tiny touch of butter or ghee, or steam gently over water. Avoid blackened or heavily peppered seasonings.
